Class ReservationService

java.lang.Object
com.leap.leaplaughlove.order.working.ReservationService
@Service public class ReservationService extends Object
Works out what an account's OPEN orders hold back, so cash or shares one open order is counting on can't be spent by another order too. An open buy holds the most it could cost (its reserved_cash); an open sell holds its shares.

Holds live only in order-app: account-app's balances don't know about them, so the check when an open order finally fills is the last line of defence (e.g. after a withdrawal).

    • QUEUED_MARKET_COLLAR

      public static final BigDecimal QUEUED_MARKET_COLLAR
      How far a market order queued for the open may fill from the price when it was queued: a buy pays at most 5% more, a sell takes at least 5% less. A buy holds cash at that most.

    • reservePricePerShare

      public static BigDecimal reservePricePerShare(Order.OrderType type, BigDecimal limitPrice, BigDecimal stopPrice)
      The most one share could cost when an order on these conditions fills: its limit for a LIMIT or STOP_LIMIT order, its stop plus STOP_BUY_BUFFER for a STOP order.

      stopPrice - the stop price, if any
      Returns:

    • reservePricePerShare

      public static BigDecimal reservePricePerShare(Order.OrderType type, BigDecimal limitPrice, BigDecimal stopPrice, BigDecimal collarPrice)
      The most one share could cost when an order on these conditions fills: its limit for a LIMIT or STOP_LIMIT order, its stop plus STOP_BUY_BUFFER for a STOP order, and its collar for a market order queued for the open.
      Parameters:
      type - the order type
      limitPrice - the limit price, if any
      stopPrice - the stop price, if any
      collarPrice - a queued market order's collar, if any
      Returns:
      the price per share to hold cash for
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - for a market order with no collar, which never waits

    • collarFor

      public static BigDecimal collarFor(Order.Side side, BigDecimal price)
      The collar for a market order queued for the open: QUEUED_MARKET_COLLAR above the ask for a buy, below the bid for a sell.
      Parameters:
      side - the order's side
      price - the side's executable price when it is queued
      Returns:
      the most a buy pays, or the least a sell takes, per share

    • explain
